framework: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (browser extension popup, no build step)
direction: iOS grouped-inset settings sheet; Filter / Scorecard segmented views

decisions.choice: Hand-built vanilla UI; 21st components are React so they serve as references only
Segmented thumb uses the Halaska 'emphasized' curve cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); chips/knobs use the spring curve cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)
Switch knob stretches on press (coss.com switch pattern)
Stat cells share one card split by hairlines (chatcn StatCardGroup)
Keyword chips spring in, 180ms exit; duplicates rejected case-insensitively
Collapsible groups animate height via ::details-content + interpolate-size
Day columns highlight on hover, value shown on hover and for today
